audience: subscription box merchants who manage their store and subscriptions on Cratejoy

useCases.title: Find active and past-due subscriptions
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriptions filtered by status and end-date range, with auto-renew and start and end dates. You see which ones need attention.

useCases.title: Review recent orders and their payment status
useCases.text: The AI lists orders in a placed-at range with payment status, fulfillment status, renewal and gift flags and totals in cents.

useCases.title: Find shipments that are not shipped yet
useCases.text: The AI lists shipments by status and creation range with target date, shipped date and tracking number, and reads one shipment in full.

useCases.title: Check failed or refunded payments
useCases.text: The AI lists payment transactions by result (authorized, captured, failed or refunded) and creation range, with the total and the order.

useCases.title: Skip or unskip a subscriber's next renewal
useCases.text: The AI skips the next renewal of a subscription, or undoes the skip. It asks for your confirmation first.

useCases.title: Retry, cancel or reactivate a subscription
useCases.text: The AI retries a failed renewal of a past-due subscription (failed within the last 30 days), cancels a subscription, or reactivates a cancelled one.
